stem.text: A uniform diving board is held by two fixed rods at points P and Q. A person stands at end R of the diving board, as shown.

stem.alt: Diving board with two fixed rods touching it at points P and Q, and a person standing at end R.

stem.text: The forces exerted by the rods on the board are vertical. The board remains in equilibrium as the person slowly moves towards point Q from end R.
Which row describes the changes to the magnitudes of the forces exerted by the rods on the board?
